Art direction study / 16 October 2026

Small beasts.
Clear personalities.

Five new concepts based on the character descriptions in ChibiBeasts: four starters and one divine. The direction uses chunky pixel shapes, simpler shading, readable silhouettes, and a few defining details for each creature.

What this demonstrates

The visual identities come from the existing descriptions. Faces, poses, and the exact arrangement of details are concept interpretations. Chronos tests whether a divine beast can feel special while keeping the same small, warm visual language as a starter.

These are AI-generated visual concepts with alpha channels, not finalized 32 × 32 production sprites. Their pixel grids, color counts, and edge transparency still need a technical cleanup pass before becoming a consistent asset set. The size buttons scale the displayed images; they do not create native-resolution sprites. The checkerboard is only the page background.

Loose ends found during the focused review

  • The roster has 82 beasts, but 13 referenced image files are absent from the local sprites folder. Their remote URLs were not tested.
  • The six guild raid boss definitions have empty image URLs, so embeds using those definitions omit their art.
  • The lore says the starter choice is still missing, but the code already implements all four starter buttons.
  • The running bot reads Cloudinary URLs. Replacing a local PNG alone would not update its displayed artwork.
